title: [3.x] HTML5 build error: Expected top-level entity
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible: Lastest version - Godot 3.4 (Github - Godot Engine v3.4.6.rc.custom_build)

### System information

Windows 10 - GeForce GT 710/PCIe/SSE2

### Issue description

I'm trying to compile Godot 3.4 (lastest Github version) to Web and I'm getting this:

> scons platform=javascript tools=no target=release -j4
